summary: Rayvatek INC. is a Taiwan-based advanced engineering company focusing on unmanned aerial systems, hydrogen energy storage, and metal additive manufacturing. Their expertise in aerospace engineering supports high-performance technologies for industrial and energy applications, but they do not operate within the semiconductor value chain.
